physicalAdmissibility.criterion: Cp + sigma = (p - pv)/qInfinity >= 0 on every sampled wetted panel; cavity BC panels are excluded.
physicalAdmissibility.scope: Equilibrium partial-sheet model consistency screen. Sensitive to discretisation near detachment and closure; not an experiment, accuracy estimate or empirical calibration.

metrics.pressureNote: Pressure residual uses a local five-point derivative of solved total potential within each boundary region (fewer points if needed), with one-sided stencils at detachment and closure. It compares to an imposed BC, not an experiment.

cavity.scope: Steady 2-D inviscid potential flow; prescribed upper partial-cavity length and detachment; algebraic pressure recovery; no re-entrant jet, viscosity, shedding, erosion or 3-D wing solution. Numerically verified prototype; cavitation predictions not experimentally validated.

provenance.formulation: Constant source/doublet mixed-potential BIE; cubic upstream detachment potential; independent wake jump and five-point total-velocity Kutta condition at adjacent TE collocation points; fixed-x nonlinear cavity updates.
provenance.closure: Numerical endpoint-root selection is separate from physical gap acceptance; a negative-gap root remains rejected. Pressure-recovery law retained. A is an additional unknown selected by a three-node derivative of the PHYSICAL gap h at the prescribed cavity end; a separate five-node derivative is reported. No endpoint value or pressure is replaced.

detachment.equationCount: 163 linear unknowns/rows per (shape, A, x_D) [velocity Kutta]; inner: m-1 node heights + qc <-> m kinematic rows with end-height closure; outer: A <-> h_x(x_E)=0 and x_D <-> beta(x_D)=0; sigma output.
detachment.note: beta is the coefficient of the square-root term of the wetted speed / s^1.5 gap term at detachment; h_x(x_D) vanishes for every beta and is reported only as a degenerate proxy.

smoothDetachment.rawReason: Inner cavity equations, closure regularity and Brillouin–Villat detachment regularity converged.

smoothDetachment.pressureGate: Core physicalAdmissibility; floating-point roundoff only. No null bypass or mesh-error allowance.
smoothDetachment.estimator: Default source cavity estimator: least-squares first FIVE interior approximate normal gaps against s^(3/2) and s^2 in original foil arclength. Four-/six-node windows and upstream speed are diagnostics.
smoothDetachment.limitation: Numerical candidate; not experimental validation or proof of a unique smooth cavity.
